issues.title: README: the install command says npm instal
issues.body: The README tells the reader to run `npm instal shop`. npm has no instal command, so the command fails. Done when the README says `npm install shop`.

comments.author: kim
comments.body: From #95: after the README command fails, an app that requires the package fails with `Error: Cannot find module 'shop'`.

issues.title: Installing shop by the README leaves the app without the module
issues.body:
I followed README.md to install shop, and the package did not install: the command there is `npm instal shop`, with one l.

Then my app failed:

```
Error: Cannot find module 'shop'
Require stack:
- /home/lee/app/index.js
    at Module._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1225:15)
    at Module._load (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1051:27)
    at Module.require (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1311:19)
    at require (node:internal/modules/helpers:179:18)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/home/lee/app/index.js:1:14)
```
